purpose: Conditional Arm64 production planning scenarios, not measured forecasts or confidence intervals

scope.runner: Standard Windows Arm64 4CPU/~16GiB per job; parallel layouts add runners, not free CPU on one runner
scope.outputs: Keep full tools/docs, native and Arm64EC libraries, supported LLVM targets, dev archives and MSI
scope.optimization: rustc frontend PGO plus effective LLVM PGO, with Rust/LLVM ThinLTO on final shipping compiler
scope.early_lto: Disabled for transient instrumentation builds in the primary planning scenarios; requires profile-quality qualification
scope.stage_cache: Primary cases reuse no instrumented/profile-use/ThinLTO objects or old profiles; ordinary seed LLVM cache varies explicitly. The separately named exact instrument-artifact cache sensitivity is an explicit exception, not a headline assumption.
scope.tool_specific_pgo: Additional cargo/rustdoc/clippy-specific instrumentation/training is not budgeted; newer opt-dist policy adds an unknown nonnegative E
scope.retained_work_sensitivity: Outputs are unchanged; additional tool LTO/relink or artifact-size costs are an unknown nonnegative U, not assumed impossible. Numeric cases set E=U=D=0.
scope.version_limit: September stock distribution is Rust 1.100-era; local/x64 component context is pinned Rust 1.94.1/LLVM21.1.8, not a matched A/B
scope.hard_bounds: None established for cold hosted Arm64 optimized stages; the stress scenario is not an upper bound
scope.qualification: Extra optimized-artifact qualification is budgeted, not a verified sufficient release test plan; ordinary test-CI jobs remain unchanged

stage_definitions.seed_llvm: Ordinary noninstrumented LLVM/LLD needed by frontend profiling; efficient case retains the observed warm cache, others budget partial/cold work
stage_definitions.frontend_instrument: Build instrumented frontend/compiler/sysroot against seed LLVM, excluding seed LLVM itself
stage_definitions.frontend_training: Fresh complete frontend corpus/modes and profile collection
stage_definitions.frontend_profile_use: Rebuild frontend with fresh profile; reused to drive backend training in the conservative pipeline
stage_definitions.llvm_instrument: Build instrumented LLVM including required tools/targets, without claiming seed-cache hits apply
stage_definitions.static_relink: Mandatory compiler/backend relink or rebuild slice to execute the instrumented static LLVM; kept separate from LLVM compilation
stage_definitions.llvm_training: Fresh complete effective backend training and profile collection; valid hosted Arm64 duration unknown
stage_definitions.final_thinlto: Integrated LLVM profile-use ThinLTO build plus every required Rust bootstrap/compiler rebuild/relink; assume no eligible earlier optimized objects, compiler-only, not retained distribution tail
stage_definitions.standalone_thinlto: Independent complete LLVM plus Rust bootstrap/compiler ThinLTO-only core budget; equal round budgets to final_thinlto are an explicit scenario convenience, not a measured equality
stage_definitions.final_without_lto: Same final profile-use rebuild with ThinLTO omitted
stage_definitions.profile_support: Additional collector/merge/provenance/orchestration work beyond the retained stock support budget
stage_definitions.extra_qualification: Additional tests of the optimized artifacts, not replacement for existing ordinary CI
stage_definitions.plain_frontend_for_backend: Independent non-frontend-instrumented compiler built against instrumented LLVM; used only in the deeper branch model
stage_definitions.backend_training_penalty: Assumed fractional slowdown using a non-PGO frontend to collect LLVM profiles
stage_definitions.handoff: Per critical artifact handoff allowance for compact compiler/profile bundles; not measured and not applicable to arbitrary whole build trees
stage_definitions.consumer_setup: Additional source/tool/config setup on a final consumer runner; not measured
stage_definitions.instrument_cache_restore: Conditional exact instrumented-LLVM artifact restore plus identity/coverage validation; no old profiles or final profile-use objects reused

budget_rationale.method: Round engineering budgets span plausible component orders and timeout risk. They are not fitted to a hardware scaling law, and are intentionally exposed for replacement by measured Arm64 stages.
budget_rationale.seed_llvm: Warm upstream LLVM/LLD is about12min with100% C/C++ hits;30/60 are cold-work sensitivities, not observed Arm64 cold durations.
budget_rationale.frontend: Local completed initial instrumentation59.73min includes LLVM and comes from a different12-core machine with8jobs; valid resumed frontend training9.58min and profile-use7.83min inform order only.
budget_rationale.backend: Valid corrected instrumentation10.2min is resumed and cannot bound cold work. Prior40.27min LLVM instrumentation belongs to invalid static-backend training; effective training time remains unknown.
budget_rationale.final: Local corrected23.55min is compiler-only with utility pruning and prior state, not a hosted full-output lower bound. Standard x64 profile-use225.78min demonstrates a large final stage is possible, not an Arm64 estimate.
budget_rationale.qualification_and_handoffs: Explicit planning allowances only; increase them if complete release qualification or transfer costs exceed budgets.

historical_x64.source: Existing persisted local-evidence.json plus parent completed-run handoff2026-10-02; no new run queried or awaited
historical_x64.build_state_caveat: Control final phase follows earlier builds in one tree; profile-use treatment is a separate job. Same profiles do not establish identical incremental/bootstrap state, so the timing ratio is not an isolated causal LTO penalty.
historical_x64.hardware: All three custom experiments standard windows-2025,4CPU16GB; compiler-only, no full distribution and no standalone utility pruning

control.classification: Completed fresh frontend/LLVM PGO, no ThinLTO

profile_reuse_thinlto.classification: Completed final profile-use compiler only; exact control frontend+LLVM profiles reused, no fresh training

initial_thinlto_attempt.classification: Timed out at350min; initial stage completed but no valid final optimized artifact
